title: Optimal and Structure-Adaptive CATE Estimation with Kernel Ridge Regression
summary: We propose an optimal algorithm for estimating conditional average treatment effects (CATEs) when response functions lie in a reproducing kernel Hilbert space (RKHS). We study settings in which the contrast function is structurally simpler than the nuisance functions: (i) it lies in a lower-complexity RKHS with faster eigenvalue decay, (ii) it satisfies a source condition relative to the nuisance kernel, or (iii) it depends on a known low-dimensional covariate representation.
